apps.desc: A small arena shooter rebuilt as an artifact and installed with its own Dock icon. The post also explains what's inside the installed app.
apps.author: de1mat

apps.name: Geography Trainer
apps.subtitle: Learn countries and capitals
apps.desc: An artifact Claude made for learning geography, installed as a desktop app.
apps.author: cjav_dev

apps.name: Titan Colony
apps.subtitle: Build a colony over 60 years
apps.desc: A planet you can install: people land on Titan and build a colony over 60 years, drawn in one shader with no libraries.
apps.author: maximbilan

apps.name: To-do List
apps.subtitle: A simple task list
apps.desc: A to-do app built in under two hours and shared with @ClaudeDevs.
apps.author: DavidCismas

apps.name: AI Architecture Survival Lab
apps.subtitle: 9 missions, 12 ways to break it
apps.desc: Design an AI system, then survive budget cuts, provider outages and security reviews across 9 missions and 12 failure modes.
apps.author: PeakGrizzly

apps.name: Podcast Lessons
apps.subtitle: Flashcards from 50+ shows
apps.desc: Highlights from Acquired, Invest Like the Best, Farnam Street and 50 other shows, turned into an interactive page with flashcards.
apps.author: SamSirapat

apps.name: Grow One Thing
apps.subtitle: Raise a bonsai, a chrysalis, more
apps.desc: Pick one of six living things, from a chrysalis (3 days) to a bonsai (60 days), and raise it through five stages into your collection.
apps.author: fighthub_jp

apps.name: Isekai Reincarnation Quiz
apps.subtitle: Which fantasy life awaits you
apps.desc: 30 pixel-art RPG scenes decide which of 16 fantasy lives you are reborn into.
apps.author: suke_aicopy

apps.name: Tarot Love Type
apps.subtitle: 320+ results, drawn as a card
apps.desc: 30 questions and 320+ results drawn as a tarot card, with attachment style and a compatibility check.
apps.author: suke_aicopy

apps.name: 500 Years of Science
apps.subtitle: Ranked scientific achievements
apps.desc: A ranked list of key scientific achievements of the last five centuries, up to the day before it was made.
apps.author: tamritzblog

apps.name: School Achievements
apps.subtitle: A school profile from one prompt
apps.desc: A full school profile site with activities, photos, vision and staff, made from a single prompt.
apps.author: Atallah147

apps.name: Signal Operator
apps.subtitle: Run every traffic light by hand
apps.desc: You switch every light at one intersection by hand. Change too early and cars crash, too late and they back up; by evening there are right-turning cars, buses and ambulances. The game ends when any direction has 8 cars waiting.
apps.author: fighthub_jp

apps.name: Exact Birthday Calculator
apps.subtitle: Your birthday, to the orbit
apps.desc: Works out the exact moment of your birthday as a whole number of trips around the sun, not a calendar date. Made by an MIT professor for people who live in a different time zone from where they were born, or were born on February 29.
apps.author: fredodurand

apps.name: Watch Out! Walking While Texting
apps.subtitle: A walk with your phone out
apps.desc: A short simulation about the danger of walking while looking at your phone. Free, no sign-up, works on phone or PC; the same post links a companion game, Walk Beside Me, and the author also has Japanese versions of both.
apps.author: s_young_sb29

apps.name: AI Document Editor
apps.subtitle: Edit .docx files with Claude
apps.desc: Open your .docx files and keep working in a real print layout with pages, headers and footers, page numbers, section breaks, columns, a table of contents, equations, comments, footnotes and tracked changes intact. Ask Claude to draft, rewrite, shorten, change tone, proofread, translate or turn text into a table; every AI edit is a tracked change you accept or reject. Dictation, read aloud and version history are built in, and it exports back to Word, PDF, Markdown, HTML or text.

apps.name: AI Spreadsheet
apps.subtitle: Excel files, Claude built in
apps.desc: Open .xlsx, .xls and .csv files with all sheets, formulas, formatting, charts and images. Ask questions in plain words and get the exact number plus the formula behind it. Build real PivotTables, data validation, conditional formatting, sparklines, grouped outlines and charts with trendlines, clean or classify thousands of rows with Claude, and save back to Excel with nothing missing.
apps.replaces: Copilot in Excel, GPT for Sheets, Formula Bot

apps.name: AI Slide Maker
apps.subtitle: Decks from a topic or your .pptx
apps.desc: Describe a talk, paste notes or drop in a .pptx, .docx or PDF, and Claude writes the slides in smart layouts and themes. Then edit like PowerPoint: shapes, pictures, tables, charts, diagrams, animations, transitions, video, slide master, sections and comments. Present with speaker notes and a pen, and export editable PowerPoint, PDF or handouts; slides you didn't touch come back exactly as they were.

apps.name: PDF Chat
apps.subtitle: Read, sign, edit and ask PDFs
apps.desc: Open PDFs, Word, PowerPoint or text files and ask questions; every answer cites its pages and highlights the exact words. Highlight, comment, draw, fill forms and sign, reorder, rotate, merge and extract pages, then save a real PDF that opens in Acrobat and Preview. Summaries, outlines, table extraction to Excel, translation and read aloud are built in, and your files stay on your device.
apps.replaces: Adobe Acrobat (AI Assistant, Fill & Sign), ChatPDF

apps.name: Grammar Checker
apps.subtitle: Grammar, clarity and tone fixes
apps.desc: Write or paste text and get live underlines for correctness, clarity, engagement and delivery, each with an explanation and one-click Accept. Rewrite any sentence shorter, clearer, more formal or friendlier, paraphrase it in 9 modes, and set goals, voice and a house style guide. Opens and saves .docx, .md and .txt, and floats on top of other apps with Option+Shift+G.

apps.name: Mind Map
apps.subtitle: Opens your Xmind and MindNode maps
apps.desc: Map ideas with Xmind and MindNode keyboard shortcuts in fourteen structures, including matrix, brace, tree table, timeline and fishbone, with a different structure per branch, with floating topics, zones, callouts, numbering, templates and version history. Open your .xmind, .opml, .mm and Markdown files and save back to the same file with Cmd+S. Claude can draft a whole map from a sentence or an article, expand any topic, summarize a branch or turn the map into an article.

apps.name: Image to Text
apps.subtitle: Copy text from any image
apps.desc: Paste a screenshot, drop photos or open a PDF, and get text you can edit, copy, read aloud or export. It keeps the layout, writes Markdown, turns tables into Excel or CSV, translates, and pulls receipts and business cards into fields. QR codes and barcodes are read on your computer.

apps.name: AI Translator
apps.subtitle: Translate, polish and explain any text
apps.desc: Paste text and Claude translates it between your two languages, polishes it so it sounds native in a natural, casual or formal tone, or explains the key words and grammar. It reads the result aloud. Installed, it floats on top and Option+Shift+T brings it up anywhere.

apps.name: Speaking Coach
apps.subtitle: Practice speaking with feedback
apps.desc: Claude writes a short spoken passage at your level in one of 9 languages and reads it to you. Repeat it or answer its question out loud, and Claude scores what you said, corrects it and reads back a more natural version.

apps.name: Pomodoro Timer
apps.subtitle: Claude plans your day into sessions
apps.desc: Dump everything you need to do and Claude turns it into ordered tasks with the number of focus sessions each needs. The timer works through them, counts down in your menu bar and Dock, notifies you when a session ends, and starts or pauses from anywhere with Option+Shift+P.

apps.name: World Clock
apps.subtitle: Time zones and meeting planner
apps.desc: Keep the cities you work with side by side, each with a day and night band. Ask in plain words, like "best time for a call with London and Tokyo", and Claude answers and moves the time slider there. Installed, the city you pick stays in your menu bar.

apps.name: Sticky Notes
apps.subtitle: Notes that float on top
apps.desc: Four colored sticky notes in one small window. Claude can turn a messy note into a checklist, clean up the writing, summarize it, suggest next steps or translate it, with one-click undo. Installed, it floats above every window and Option+Shift+J hides it or brings it back.

apps.name: The Future of AI
apps.subtitle: A 3D deck you fly through
apps.desc: A presentation on the future of AI and the intelligence explosion where every slide is a full 3D scene, joined by camera moves and sound. Takes about eight minutes to watch; the author says an early Opus 5.6 built it.
apps.author: fluxxrider

apps.name: Zone of Protection
apps.subtitle: A 60-second hand-hygiene test
apps.desc: A 60-second hand-hygiene challenge scored like an antibiotic sensitivity plate: S, I or R.
apps.author: drasumant

apps.name: Mac Cleaner
apps.subtitle: A disk cleaner built in a chat
apps.desc: A Mac cleaning app the author always wanted, built in Claude and installed as a desktop app; the post shows it running.
apps.author: joseamijares

apps.name: AI Video Studio
apps.subtitle: Topic in, MP4 out
apps.desc: Describe a video or paste a script and Claude writes an animated storyboard. Edit scenes on a timeline, add built-in music or your own song with cuts snapped to the beat, burn in captions, and export MP4 or WebM in 16:9, 9:16 or 1:1.

apps.name: AI Design Studio
apps.subtitle: Screens, pages, graphics, critiques
apps.desc: Describe an app or a business, or drop in a screenshot, and Claude designs mobile screens you can click through, landing pages in 2 to 3 styles, or posters and social graphics, all sharing one design system you can change live. Get a scored critique with one-click fixes, and export PNG, HTML/CSS, SVG or design tokens.

apps.name: AI Thinking Partner
apps.subtitle: Think it through, then ship
apps.desc: Paste a plan, idea or decision and Claude asks the hard questions, each with a recommended answer you can accept in one keystroke. A live map tracks resolved, open and parked questions, plus terms, decisions and risks. Export a spec, PRD, questionnaire, tickets for Linear or Jira, or a handoff brief.

apps.name: Saltline
apps.subtitle: First-person shooter, built from scratch
apps.desc: A full first-person shooter Felix Rieseberg had Fable 5.2 build from one-shot prompts. Every model, sound and texture is generated in code, with no outside assets.
apps.author: felixrieseberg

apps.name: Weird Web Demos
apps.subtitle: HTML-in-Canvas playground
apps.desc: A set of odd, animated demos that show off HTML-in-Canvas in the Claude desktop apps, made by the engineer who switched it on. Flash-era fun in one page.
apps.author: felixrieseberg

apps.name: Nori Desktop Shark
apps.subtitle: A shark pet for your desktop
apps.desc: A small shark swims along the bottom of your screen once you install it as an app. Rub it, double-click its fin to make it leap, or right-click to toss it fish.
apps.author: felixrieseberg

apps.name: Felt
apps.subtitle: Seamless felt texture generator
apps.desc: Draws seamless felt-like background textures live with a shader. Pick the colour, pattern, tile size and resolution, then download a 1024 px tile.
apps.author: A-Marko

apps.name: Facade Synth
apps.subtitle: Build a street like a synth
apps.desc: A synthesiser for Georgian terrace streets: turn knobs and step a sequencer where each step is one house. Randomise, mutate, snapshot and save designs as patch code.
apps.author: Tomasmillar

apps.name: Daisy Tube
apps.subtitle: Make a computer sing
apps.desc: Recreates the 1961 Bell Labs voice that sang Daisy Bell. Drag the scope to shape a vowel in a 44-section vocal tube and adjust pitch, lips and breath.
apps.author: Ok_Nectarine_4445

apps.name: Gigantua
apps.subtitle: Fly around a black hole
apps.desc: An interactive black hole: hover, orbit or fall in and watch light bend around it. Toggle Doppler and redshift effects, or take the guided tour with sound.
apps.author: robotsmakelove
